record.question: Who is the recently appointed Governor of West Bengal?
record.explanation: Answer A: M.K.Narayanan. M. K. Narayanan was appointed Governor of West Bengal in the President's 16 January 2010 announcement, making him the recently appointed governor for the March 2010 paper. Historical/source note: Recent relative to the March 2010 examination. Reference: https://presidentofindia.nic.in/smt-pratibha-devisingh-patil/press_releases/president-appoints-governors-0. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
